packages.title: Packages
packages.description: npm package names, e.g. "react" or a scoped package "@babel/core". One lookup is billed per package.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: Only return versions published within this many days of today.

maxResultsPerPackage.title: Max results per package
maxResultsPerPackage.description: Maximum number of published versions to return per package, most recent first.
